Proof in the paper: The peaks at 44.3°, 51.5°, and 75.8° correspond to the (111), (200), and (220) planes of Awaruite phase FeNi3 (JCPDS: 38-0419) respectively, while the characteristic carbon peak at around 26° can be indexed to (002) graphitic plane, deriving from the carbonization of -CN groups in the PBA precursor. Hence, we suggest that Ni-Fe PBA can be successfully converted into NiFe@NC after carbonization treatment.
